product_metadata.title: Keeko Brown Faux Cowhide Rug, 5.2x6.2ft Large Cow Rugs for Living Room, Non-Rolling Up, Premium Bedroom Cow Print Rugs with Non-Slip Backing for Western Home Decor
features: Various Sizes of Cowhide Rug: There are three sizes: 2.3x3.6ft; 4.6x5.2ft; 5.2x6.2ft, which is suitable for different place, such as foyer, sofa, living room, office and bedroom. It can decorate them perfectly.

3D Printing And Dyeing Crafted, Realistic And Premium: Modern and simple cow print carpet, which using 3D HD printing process, the effect is realistic, but never kill. We value all the animal and admire nature.

Short Fluff, Comfortable And Has A Good Vibe: This faux cowhide rug is made of high-quality faux fur. Although the fluff is short, it offers the soft and cozy touch. Meanwhile add texture and interest to your room.

Strong Adsorption Force, No Curling: This cow print rug comes with a non-slip backing of artificial suede, which adheres well to the floor and wrinkle-free. It will stay in place even on slippery floors.

Dirt Resistant And Convenient Cleaning: Simply vacuum cow hide rug with a hand-held vacuum for daily cleaning. If a deeper cleaning is needed, machine wash separately on the gentle cycle with mild detergent. Do not tumble or machine dry, and let air dry flat.
